text_en: Then Jesus called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons and to cure diseases,
text_cn: 耶稣召集了那十二人来，赐给他们制伏一切魔鬼，并治疗疾病的能力和权柄，

text_en: and he sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal.
text_cn: 派遣他们去宣讲天主的国，并治好病人，

text_en: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey, no staff, nor bag, nor bread, nor money—not even an extra tunic.
text_cn: 向他们说：“你们在路上什么也不要带：也不要带棍杖，也不要带口袋，也不要带食物，也不要带银钱也不要带两件内衣。

text_en: Whatever house you enter, stay there, and leave from there.
text_cn: 你们无论进了哪一家，就住在那里，直到从那里离去。

text_en: Wherever they do not welcome you, as you are leaving that town shake the dust off your feet as a testimony against them. ”
text_cn: 人若不接待你们，你们要离开那城，拂去你们脚上的尘土，作为反对他们的证据。”

text_en: They departed and went through the villages, bringing the good news and curing diseases everywhere.
text_cn: 他们就出发，周游各乡村，宣传喜讯，到处治病。

text_en: Now Herod the ruler heard about all that had taken place, and he was perplexed, because it was said by some that John had been raised from the dead,
text_cn: 分封候黑落德听到发生的这一切事，犹豫不定，因为有些人说：“若翰从死者中复活了。”

text_en: by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the ancient prophets had arisen.
text_cn: 但另有些人说：“是厄里亚出现了。”还有些人说：“是一位古先知复活了。”

text_en: Herod said, “John I beheaded; but who is this about whom I hear such things? ” And he tried to see him.
text_cn: 黑落德且说：“若翰我已经斩首了；而这人到底是谁？关于他，我竟听到了这样的事！”便想法看看他。

text_en: On their return the apostles told Jesus all they had done. He took them with him and withdrew privately to a city called Bethsaida.
text_cn: 宗徒们回来，把所行的一切报告给耶稣，他遂带着他们私自退往一座名叫贝特赛达的城去了。

text_en: When the crowds found out about it, they followed him; and he welcomed them, and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and healed those who needed to be cured.
text_cn: 群众一知道，也跟随他去了；他就迎接他们，给他们讲论天主的国，并治好了那些急需要治疗的人。

text_en: The day was drawing to a close, and the twelve came to him and said, “Send the crowd away, so that they may go into the surrounding villages and countryside, to lodge and get provisions; for we are here in a deserted place. ”
text_cn: 天将要黑的时候，那十二人前来对他说：“请遣散群众，叫他们往四周村庄田舍里去投宿寻食，因为我们这里，是在荒野地方。”

text_en: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat. ” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish—unless we are to go and buy food for all these people. ”
text_cn: 耶稣却向他们说：“你们给他们吃的罢！”他们答说：“我们不过只有五个饼和两条鱼，除非我们亲自去给这一切人购买食物。”

text_en: For there were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each. ”
text_cn: 原来男人大约有五千。他却对自己的门徒说：“叫他们分伙坐下，约五十人一伙。”

text_en: They did so and made them all sit down.
text_cn: 门徒就照样做了，叫众人坐下。

text_en: And taking the five loaves and the two fish, he looked up to heaven, and blessed and broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the crowd.
text_cn: 他遂拿起那五个饼和那两条鱼来，望着天祝福了，擘(bāi)开递给门徒，叫他们摆在群众前。

text_en: And all ate and were filled. What was left over was gathered up, twelve baskets of broken pieces.
text_cn: 众人吃了，也都饱了；把他们所剩的碎块，收集了十二筐。

text_en: Once when Jesus was praying alone, with only the disciples near him, he asked them, “Who do the crowds say that I am? ”
text_cn: 有一天，耶稣独自祈祷，门徒同他在一起。他问他们说：“众人说我是谁？”

text_en: They answered, “John the Baptist; but others, Elijah; and still others, that one of the ancient prophets has arisen. ”
text_cn: 他们回答说：“有人说是洗者若翰；有人却说是厄里亚；还有人说是古时的一位先知复活了。”

text_en: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am? ” Peter answered, “The Messiah of God. ”
text_cn: 他问他们说：“但你们说我是谁呢？”伯多禄回答说：“天主的受傅者。”

text_en: He sternly ordered and commanded them not to tell anyone,
text_cn: 但耶稣严厉嘱咐他们，不要把这事告诉人，

text_en: saying, “The Son of Man must undergo great suffering, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and on the third day be raised. ”
text_cn: 说：“人子必须受许多苦，被长老、司祭长和经师们弃绝，并且要被杀；但第三天必要复活。”

text_en: Then he said to them all, “If any want to become my followers, let them deny themselves and take up their cross daily and follow me.
text_cn: 他又对众人说：“谁若愿意跟随我，该弃绝自己，天天背着自己的十字架跟随我。

text_en: For those who want to save their life will lose it, and those who lose their life for my sake will save it.
text_cn: 因为谁若愿意救自己的性命，必要丧失性命；但谁若为我的原故丧失自己的性命，这人必能救得性命。

text_en: What does it profit them if they gain the whole world, but lose or forfeit themselves?
text_cn: 人纵然赚得了全世界，却丧失了自己，或赔上自己，为他有什么益处呢？

text_en: Those who are ashamed of me and of my words, of them the Son of Man will be ashamed when he comes in his glory and the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.
text_cn: 谁若以我和我的话为耻，将来人子在自己的光荣，和父及众圣天使的光荣中降来时，也要以这人为耻。

text_en: But truly I tell you, there are some standing here who will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God. ”
text_cn: 我确实告诉你们：站在这里的人中，就有几个在未尝到死味以前，必要看见天主的国。”

text_en: Now about eight days after these sayings Jesus took with him Peter and John and James, and went up on the mountain to pray.
text_cn: 讲了这些道理以后，大约过了八天，耶稣带着伯多禄、若望和雅各伯上山去祈祷。

text_en: And while he was praying, the appearance of his face changed, and his clothes became dazzling white.
text_cn: 正当他祈祷时，他的面容改变，他的衣服洁白发光。

text_en: Suddenly they saw two men, Moses and Elijah, talking to him.
text_cn: 忽然，有两个人，即梅瑟和厄里亚，同他谈话。

text_en: They appeared in glory and were speaking of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
text_cn: 他们出显在光耀中，谈论耶稣的去世，即他在耶路撒冷必要完成的事。

text_en: Now Peter and his companions were weighed down with sleep; but since they had stayed awake, they saw his glory and the two men who stood with him.
text_cn: 伯多禄和同他在一起的，都昏昏欲睡。他们一醒，就看见他的光耀和在他旁侍立的两个人。

text_en: Just as they were leaving him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here; let us make three dwellings, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah”—not knowing what he said.
text_cn: 那二人正要离开时，伯多禄对耶稣说：“老师，我们在这里真好！让我们搭三个帐棚：一个为你，一个为梅瑟，一个为厄里亚。”他原来不知道说什么了。

text_en: While he was saying this, a cloud came and overshadowed them; and they were terrified as they entered the cloud.
text_cn: 他说这话的时候，有一片云彩遮蔽了他们。他们进入云彩时，门徒们就害怕起来。

text_en: Then from the cloud came a voice that said, “This is my Son, my Chosen; listen to him! ”
text_cn: 云中有声音说：“这是我的儿子，我所拣选的，你们要听从他！”

text_en: When the voice had spoken, Jesus was found alone. And they kept silent and in those days told no one any of the things they had seen.
text_cn: 正有这声音时，只见耶稣独自一人。在那些日子，他们都守了秘密，把所见的事一点也没有告诉任何人。

text_en: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great crowd met him.
text_cn: 第二天，他们从山上下来，一大群人来迎接他。

text_en: Just then a man from the crowd shouted, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son; he is my only child.
text_cn: 看，从群众中有一个人喊叫说：“师傅，求你怜视我的儿子，因为他是我的独生子；

text_en: Suddenly a spirit seizes him, and all at once he shrieks. It convulses him until he foams at the mouth; it mauls him and will scarcely leave him.
text_cn: 魔鬼一抓住他，便使他突然狂叫，使他痉挛至于吐沫，叫他筋疲力尽了，还是不肯离开他。

text_en: I begged your disciples to cast it out, but they could not. ”
text_cn: 我求了你的门徒把魔鬼逐出，他们却不能。”

text_en: Jesus answered, “You faithless and perverse generation, how much longer must I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here. ”
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“哎！无信而败坏的世代！我同你们在一起，并容忍你们直到几时呢？领你的儿子到这里来罢！”

text_en: While he was coming, the demon dashed him to the ground in convulsions. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.
text_cn: 当他走过来时，魔鬼还把他摔倒，使他痉挛。耶稣一叱责邪魔，就治好了孩子，把他交给了他的父亲。

text_en: And all were astounded at the greatness of God. While everyone was amazed at all that he was doing, he said to his disciples,
text_cn: 众人都惊讶天主的伟大。 当众人惊奇耶稣所作的一切时，他向自己的门徒说：

text_en: “Let these words sink into your ears: The Son of Man is going to be betrayed into human hands. ”
text_cn: “你们应谨记这些话：人子将要被交于人手中。”

text_en: But they did not understand this saying; its meaning was concealed from them, so that they could not perceive it. And they were afraid to ask him about this saying.
text_cn: 但他们不明了这话，这话为他们还是蒙蔽着，不叫他们了解；他们又怕问他这话的意思。

text_en: An argument arose among them as to which one of them was the greatest.
text_cn: 他们心中起了一个思想：谁是他们中最大的。

text_en: But Jesus, aware of their inner thoughts, took a little child and put it by his side,
text_cn: 耶稣看透了他们的心思，就领来一个小孩子，叫他立在自己身边，

text_en: and said to them, “Whoever welcomes this child in my name welcomes me, and whoever welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me; for the least among all of you is the greatest. ”
text_cn: 对他们说：“谁若为了我的名字收留这个小孩子，就是收留我；谁若收留我，就是收留那派遣我来的；因为在你们众人中最小的，这人才是最大的。”

text_en: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we tried to stop him, because he does not follow with us. ”
text_cn: 若望说：“老师！我们曾看见一个人，因你的名字驱魔，就禁止了他，因为他不与我们同伙。”

text_en: But Jesus said to him, “Do not stop him; for whoever is not against you is for you. ”
text_cn: 耶稣却向他说：“不要禁止！因为谁不反对你们，就是倾向你们。”

text_en: When the days drew near for him to be taken up, he set his face to go to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 耶稣被接升天的日期，就快要来到，他遂决意面朝耶路撒冷走去，

text_en: And he sent messengers ahead of him. On their way they entered a village of the Samaritans to make ready for him;
text_cn: 便打发使者在他前面走；他们去了，进了撒玛黎雅人的一个村庄，好为他准备住宿。

text_en: but they did not receive him, because his face was set toward Jerusalem.
text_cn: 人们却不收留他，因为他是面朝耶路撒冷去的。

text_en: When his disciples James and John saw it, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from heaven and consume them? ”
text_cn: 雅各伯及若望两个门徒见了，便说：“主，你愿意我们叫火自天降下，焚毁他们吗？”

text_en: But he turned and rebuked them.
text_cn: 耶稣转过身来斥责了他们。

text_en: Then they went on to another village.
text_cn: 他们遂又到别的村庄去了。

text_en: As they were going along the road, someone said to him, “I will follow you wherever you go. ”
text_cn: 他们正走的时候，在路上有一个人对耶稣说：“你不论往哪里去，我要跟随你。”

text_en: And Jesus said to him, “Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head. ”
text_cn: 耶稣给他说：“狐狸有穴，天上的飞鸟有巢；但是人子却没有枕头的地方。”

text_en: To another he said, “Follow me. ” But he said, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father. ”
text_cn: 又对另一个人说：“你跟随我罢！”那人却说：“主，请许我先去埋葬我的父亲。”

text_en: But Jesus said to him, “Let the dead bury their own dead; but as for you, go and proclaim the kingdom of God. ”
text_cn: 耶稣给他说：“任凭死人去埋葬自己的死人罢！至于你，你要去宣扬天主的国。”

text_en: Another said, “I will follow you, Lord; but let me first say farewell to those at my home. ”
text_cn: 又有一个人说：“主！我要跟随你；但请许我先告别我的家人。”

text_en: Jesus said to him, “No one who puts a hand to the plow and looks back is fit for the kingdom of God. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“手扶着犁而往后看的，不适于天主的国。”
